description: Complete synthesizer voice: two oscillators with FM and sync, a distortion stage, the Vult filter collection, two envelopes, an LFO, a random generator, delay and reverb, and an eight slot router

params.text: Sets the range of that oscillator's TUNE knob: FINE is a semitone up and down, COARSE is an octave up and down, SEMI is an octave up and down quantized to semitones
Offsets the pitch of oscillator A over the range set by its tune mode switch
Offsets oscillator A in octaves
Sets the pulse width of oscillator A, which changes the shape of all three of its waves and not only the pulse
Picks the wave of oscillator A: PULSE, SAW or TRI
Offsets the pitch of oscillator B over the range set by its tune mode switch
Offsets oscillator B in octaves
Sets the harmonic content of oscillator B, from the bare fundamental to the full wave, much like a lowpass filter placed ahead of the filter section
Morphs oscillator B continuously between its waves
Crossfades between oscillator A and oscillator B
OFF leaves oscillator B free running, ON hard-syncs it to oscillator A, DETACH frees it from the incoming pitch so it can be tuned on its own as a drone or a modulator
Folds the wave to one side of centre, which adds overtones, and degrades it to the other, which gives a lo-fi sound
A second distortion stage, shaping the waveform
PRE puts the distortion ahead of the filter, where the filter can tame it; POST puts it after, where it reaches the output untouched
Sets the frequency at which the filter starts to act: fully counter-clockwise it is closed, fully clockwise it is open
Boosts the frequencies near the cutoff of the filter
Sets how much signal enters the filter, and raising it saturates the filter and adds harmonics
Sets the attack time of the amplifier envelope
Sets the decay time of the amplifier envelope
Sets the sustain level of the amplifier envelope
Sets the release time of the amplifier envelope
Sets the attack time of the ENV envelope
Sets the decay time of the ENV envelope
Sets the delay time
Sets how much of the output is sent to the delay
Sets how much the ENV envelope changes the cutoff
Sets how much the ENV envelope changes the wave morph of oscillator B
Sets how much the ENV envelope changes the pulse width of oscillator A
Sets how much the ENV envelope changes the crossfade between the oscillators
Sets how much the LFO changes the wave morph of oscillator B
Sets how much the LFO changes the pulse width of oscillator A
Sets how much the LFO changes the cutoff
Sets how much the LFO changes the crossfade between the oscillators
Sets the LFO rate
Picks the LFO wave: TRI, SAW or PULSE
ON restarts the LFO on every gate
Sets the frequency of the modulator that frequency-modulates oscillator B
Sets how much oscillator B is frequency modulated
RATIO locks the modulator to a multiple of the main pitch, which keeps the result harmonic; FREE runs it at a fixed frequency, for inharmonic and bell-like results that do not track the keyboard
Adds a sub oscillator below the main pitch for extra weight
Sets the maximum rate at which the pitch follows a change of the PITCH input
Sets how much the cutoff follows the pitch of the note
Sets how much the VEL input changes the level the amplifier envelope reaches
Sets how much the VEL input changes the depth of the ENV envelope
Tunes both oscillators together
UNI gives a unipolar LFO, BI a bipolar one
Sets the rate at which the random generator changes
Picks the randomness: CAUDAL is the chaotic pendulum and gives smooth interrelated movement, BROWN is brownian motion and wanders gradually, STEPS jumps between discrete values
UNI gives a unipolar random signal, BI a bipolar one
Sets how much the random generator changes the wave morph of oscillator B
Sets how much the random generator changes the pulse width of oscillator A
Sets how much the random generator changes the cutoff
Sets how much the random generator changes the crossfade between the oscillators
Sets how much the velocity changes the cutoff
Sets the amount of reverb added to the output
Turns oscillator A on and off
Steps to the next filter model, among Vortex, Unstabile, Lateralus, Tangents, Stabile, Ferox, Nurage, Rescomb and Vorg
Steps to the previous filter model, among Vortex, Unstabile, Lateralus, Tangents, Stabile, Ferox, Nurage, Rescomb and Vorg
Steps to the next response of the filter model in use, such as lowpass, bandpass or highpass
Steps to the previous response of the filter model in use, such as lowpass, bandpass or highpass
Attenuates and inverts the modulation input of the same number before it reaches the control assigned to that slot
Assigns that modulation slot: press it, then move the control the slot should change

inputs.text: A gate that triggers both envelopes
The velocity of the note, which changes the amplifier envelope, the ENV envelope and the cutoff by the amounts their VEL controls set
A clock that samples and holds the LFO
A clock that samples and holds the random generator
A control voltage for the control assigned to the modulation slot of the same number

outputs.text: The left channel of the voice
The right channel of the voice
The signal from the random generator

notes: the sections are normalled to each other inside the module, so a pitch and a gate are enough to get sound.
